name: com.rowhousesoftware/penny-packet
title: Penny Packet
description: Tie a bank month to the statement to the cent, and compare it to the budget.

tools.name: tie_out_month
tools.description: Checks one month of a bank CSV against the starting and statement balances, to the cent. Gives the deposits, the withdrawals, what the lines add up to, how far off it is, running balance breaks that point to a missing line, possible double payments and bank fees, and a list of who was paid. Also gives a link to a one page PDF for the board. Plain code, nothing is guessed.

bank_csv.description: The bank's CSV export for one checking or savings account, as text with its header row. Works with Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citi, Capital One, U.S. Bank, PNC, TD, Navy Federal and most credit unions.

month.description: The month to report, like 2026-10. Defaults to the month with the most lines in the file.

starting_balance.description: The balance at the start of the month, like "12,480.55". Leave it out if the bank file shows it.

ending_balance.description: The ending balance on the bank statement, like "12,480.55". Leave it out if the bank file shows it.

account_name.description: What the group calls this account, like Operating checking.

group_name.description: The HOA, club or PTA name, for the PDF heading.

tools.name: budget_vs_actual
tools.description: Puts one month of a bank CSV next to the group's budget: budget, actual and over or under for each category, for the month and the year so far, plus the bank tie-out. Payees go into categories by the categories map; anything not sorted is listed so it can be added. Also gives a link to a one page PDF for the board.

bank_csv.description: The bank's CSV export for one checking or savings account, as text with its header row. Works with Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citi, Capital One, U.S. Bank, PNC, TD, Navy Federal and most credit unions.

month.description: The month to report, like 2026-10. Defaults to the month with the most lines in the file.

starting_balance.description: The balance at the start of the month, like "12,480.55". Leave it out if the bank file shows it.

ending_balance.description: The ending balance on the bank statement, like "12,480.55". Leave it out if the bank file shows it.

account_name.description: What the group calls this account, like Operating checking.

group_name.description: The HOA, club or PTA name, for the PDF heading.

budget_csv.description: The budget as CSV text: a Category column and an Annual or Monthly amount, or a column for each month. A Type column (income or expense) helps.

categories.description: Which category each payee goes in, like {"GEORGIA POWER": "Utilities", "STATE FARM INSURANCE": "Insurance"}. Use the payee names from the tie-out or the bank description.

fiscal_start_month.description: The month the budget year starts, 1 for January.

group_type.description: Sets the starting list of categories. Defaults to hoa.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: Says what the paid Penny Packet plan adds on the website, what it costs and where to start. Nothing is bought here.
